_about: News sources for In the Loop: outlets (RSS/Atom feeds, and which domains count from GDELT) and the GDELT queries per region. Read by scripts/collect-news.js. Only articles from outlets listed here are shown. stateAffiliated outlets are shown and labelled (Amir, 22 Nov 2026). affiliation matches voices.example.json so an outlet's Bluesky post and its article are one source, not two.

gdelt._about: GDELT is switched off (queries moved to disabledQueries) since 23 Nov 2026: every call from GitHub's runners got HTTP 429, it has no Reuters, AP, Haaretz, Times of Israel, CNN or RFE/RL articles, and its index lagged many hours. Move the queries back to 'queries' to try again, e.g. from a server with its own address. See docs/research/news.md.

telegram._about: Public Telegram channels read from their web preview (https://t.me/s/<channel>) by scripts/collect-news.js. English channels only (Amir, 23 Nov 2026: the Ukrainian ones were removed because non-English posts crowded the pages; they are backlogged in docs/workstreams/sources.md); more candidates in docs/research/telegram.md. Since 28 Nov 2026 (Amir, World Monitor review) partisan channels and anonymous OSINT aggregators are included too, labelled 'partisan' or 'unverified' in src/credibility.js: they show, but never confirm a story. Still no channels run by designated armed groups themselves (IRGC, Hezbollah, Houthis); all of those found are Persian or Arabic anyway. affiliation matches the outlet's feed/Bluesky voice so they count as one source. tier: 1 outlet, 4 official, 5 OSINT. Posts are kept as short excerpts with a link; Telegram's terms ban any AI use of its content.
